mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_version (tenant_id, agent_id, version_no, status, role_name, role_code, business_background, responsibilities, sdlc_id, identity_json, reviewer_id, review_comment, reviewed_at, creator_id, is_deleted, version) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{agentId}, #{versionNo}, #{status}, #{roleName}, #{roleCode}, #{businessBackground}, #{responsibilities}, #{sdlcId}, #{identityJson}, #{reviewerId}, #{reviewComment}, #{reviewedAt}, #{creatorId}, 0, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM agent_version WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM agent_version WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND version_no = #{versionNo} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM agent_version WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY version_no DESC
SELECT * FROM agent_version WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND status = 'APPROVED' AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY version_no DESC

SELECT DISTINCT a.id FROM agent a JOIN agent_version av ON av.id = a.online_version_id AND av.agent_id = a.id WHERE av.sdlc_id = #{sdlcId} AND av.is_deleted = 0 AND a.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY a.id LIMIT 5

SELECT DISTINCT av.sdlc_id, av.agent_id FROM agent_version av JOIN agent a ON a.online_version_id = av.id AND a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.is_deleted = 0 WHERE av.is_deleted = 0 AND av.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND av.sdlc_id IN
#{sdid}
(NULL)
ORDER BY av.sdlc_id, av.agent_id
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_version SET role_name = #{roleName}, role_code = #{roleCode}, business_background = #{businessBackground}, responsibilities = #{responsibilities}, sdlc_id = #{sdlcId}, identity_json = #{identityJson}, version = version + 1, modifier_id = #{modifierId} WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND version = #{version} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE agent_version SET is_deleted = 1, version = version + 1, modifier_id = #{modifierId} WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = 0
